text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race for the final crown, the Kikuka 
Sho, had finally arrived—under less than 
ideal weather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if mirroring the overcast sky, a heavy 
mood hangs over the venue.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, Logo isn't here either. Going by 
track records, Epi's pretty much the only 
one, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Even if I go out of control 
like before, I can probably still win, 
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...The excitement seems to have died down 
a bit, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I shall carve my own path with my 
legs. That is—an Umamusume's mission."

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Rain... We're gonna get wet. What 
a drag. The girls running in the race are 
gonna have it rough too...

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...The racing world really is harsh, 
isn't it? ...Maybe it's just impossible 
for me."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I can win! Because—destiny loves me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She shouted with supreme confidence, just 
as she always did. Her bright, unchanged 
voice felt like it could clear away the 
heavy, humid air.
choice_data_list: Still, today isn't just about winning.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll make everyone feel that it's 
destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I prepared with you— A way of 
winning that everyone will admire!"
choice_data_list: Are you feeling okay right now?
Are you feeling alright right now?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I feel super calm. I truly feel 
that everything is going to be completely 
fine!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...You remember the promise we made this 
summer, right? Watch me from the best seat 
in the house!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll make you feel destiny too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, it's her battle alone. 
If that's the case, I want to get her 
completely hyped up before sending her 
off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What came to mind was ballet practice— 
Actual ballet might be out of the 
question, but maybe I can manage a little 
dance."
choice_data_list: Epi, wanna dance... just a little?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
An impromptu dance? That's awesome! Let's 
do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment, Epiphaneia's arm was 
wrapped around my waist.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: Um... aren't you a bit too close?
Um... aren't you a bit close?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: This is great!! I can see you clearly now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! This is so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, we'll continue this after the 
race! The voice of destiny says that's for 
the best, too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I shall lift you up in the winner's 
circle!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, rain...!! Bad track conditions for a 
long-distance race is crazy... I wonder if 
the pace will be slow...?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I seriously need to watch out so it 
doesn't drain all my stamina... Ahhhhh, 
for real, I can't take this—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —It's not impossible!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Epiphaneia appeared, the sky 
lit up completely for an instant, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The rain had stopped.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No matter how difficult the path! I'll 
blaze my own trail—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My very own path to victory! And to become 
the most dazzling star—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I shall bestow a happy destiny upon 
everyone!
